purpose: Regression patterns that must be caught before compounding; not aesthetic optimization rules.

records.rule: Same raw µL after 10% -> neat stock change produces 10x active dose.
Lemonile 10% -> neat with unchanged raw µL produces 10x active dose; temporal OAV is corroborating screening evidence.
Static or temporal OAV dominance alone cannot prove percent contribution, exact intensity, target mismatch, or bad smell.
